duck.description: Lower the tracked body or press Down/S.

jump.description: Lift the tracked body or press Up/Space.

armsRaised.description: Raise both wrists or press E/gamepad Y.

body.move.description: Normalized step and lean intent from 101 Link or conventional controls.

body.description: Flattened 33-point body pose. The game plays without it; every control it feeds has a conventional fallback.
